mapper.update: INSERT INTO board_stats_daily (stat_date, board_id, total_views, unique_visitors, post_count, comment_count, avg_response_ms, aggregated_at) SELECT #{targetDate}::date AS stat_date, COALESCE( NULLIF((regexp_match(page_url, '^/board/(\d+)'))[1], '')::bigint, 1 ) AS board_id, COUNT(*)::int AS total_views, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash)::int AS unique_visitors, 0::int AS post_count, 0::int AS comment_count, COALESCE(AVG(response_time_ms)::int, 0) AS avg_response_ms, NOW() AS aggregated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' AND page_url ~ '^/board/' GROUP BY board_id ON CONFLICT (stat_date, board_id) DO UPDATE SET total_views = EXCLUDED.total_views, unique_visitors = EXCLUDED.unique_visitors, post_count = EXCLUDED.post_count, comment_count = EXCLUDED.comment_count, avg_response_ms = EXCLUDED.avg_response_ms, aggregated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO board_stats_monthly (stat_month, board_id, total_views, unique_visitors, post_count, comment_count, aggregated_at) SELECT #{targetMonth} AS stat_month, board_id, SUM(total_views)::int AS total_views, SUM(unique_visitors)::int AS unique_visitors, SUM(post_count)::int AS post_count, SUM(comment_count)::int AS comment_count, NOW() FROM board_stats_daily WHERE TO_CHAR(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY board_id ON CONFLICT (stat_month, board_id) DO UPDATE SET total_views = EXCLUDED.total_views, unique_visitors = EXCLUDED.unique_visitors, post_count = EXCLUDED.post_count, comment_count = EXCLUDED.comment_count, aggregated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO content_view_stats_daily (stat_date, content_id, view_count, unique_viewers, avg_dwell_sec, aggregated_at) SELECT #{targetDate}::date AS stat_date, (regexp_match(page_url, '^/contents/(\d+)'))[1]::bigint AS content_id, COUNT(*)::int AS view_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ip_hash)::int AS unique_viewers, 30::int AS avg_dwell_sec, NOW() FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' AND page_url ~ '^/contents/\d+' GROUP BY content_id ON CONFLICT (stat_date, content_id) DO UPDATE SET view_count = EXCLUDED.view_count, unique_viewers = EXCLUDED.unique_viewers, avg_dwell_sec = EXCLUDED.avg_dwell_sec, aggregated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO content_view_stats_monthly (stat_month, content_id, view_count, unique_viewers, aggregated_at) SELECT #{targetMonth} AS stat_month, content_id, SUM(view_count)::int AS view_count, SUM(unique_viewers)::int AS unique_viewers, NOW() FROM content_view_stats_daily WHERE TO_CHAR(stat_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{targetMonth} GROUP BY content_id ON CONFLICT (stat_month, content_id) DO UPDATE SET view_count = EXCLUDED.view_count, unique_viewers = EXCLUDED.unique_viewers, aggregated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO policy_match_stats_monthly (stat_month, policy_id, match_count, apply_count, apply_conversion_rate, success_count, aggregated_at) VALUES (#{targetMonth}, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (stat_month, policy_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO safety_stats_monthly (stat_month, incident_category, incident_count, casualty_count, severity_avg, aggregated_at) VALUES (#{targetMonth}, 'PLACEHOLDER', 0, 0, 0, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (stat_month, incident_category) DO NOTHING
